description: 一批可开关的原版改动（共 14 条规则）：炼药锅结冰与产物、水桶/水瓶不消耗、村民低价与声望调价、铁傀儡不主动攻击玩家、新手村民交易不重置、火药点火、村民与傻子可逆转化、图书管理员售卖全部宝藏附魔书等。A Carpet add-on with 14 toggleable vanilla tweaks: cauldron freezing and its product, non-consuming buckets and bottles, villager trade prices and reputation, passive iron golems, persistent novice trades, ignitable gunpowder, reversible villager/nitwit conversion, and librarian trades for every treasure enchantment book.
